title: L-Arginine for Hair: What the Research Shows
seo_title: L-Arginine for Hair Loss & Growth: What the Research Shows | FullyVital
seo_description: What a 2025 study found about arginine and pattern hair loss, what nitric oxide does in the hair follicle, and how much arginine has been tested for safety.
notes: Citation style v2: 3 studies, each cited once, all in the second half; Key Takeaways and FAQ carry no links.
Old post (0 study links) claimed hair growth and blood-flow benefits. Removed; rewritten around the 2025 study, nitric oxide in the follicle and a human safety trial.
flags: The closing FullyVital product box (unchanged, sitewide) says products 'Promote Hair Regrowth'. Left for you, as with boron.
Discusses androgenetic alopecia research; informational, not a product claim. Check against your claims policy.
The 2025 study is lab/animal plus serum metabolomics in patients; the article says no trial shows oral arginine works.
'Arginine is converted by NOS to citrulline and nitric oxide' is from the Sowden abstract.
